lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Hey, babe. You've got your news face on.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, greeting] hey, babe. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, teasing] you've got your news face on.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I do have news. But you go first. I can wait.
lines.script: [fast, excited] I [emphasized] DO have news. [impatient] But you go first,I can wait...

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Sure. So I got up this morning, and I was thinking about toast...
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, slow] sure. so i got up this morning, [mellow, laid-back, low-key, trailing off] and i was thinking about toast...

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A FISH was wearing my mom's muffin pan. As a crown. I'm so sorry. Please. Toast.
lines.script: [blurting, very fast] A [emphasized] FISH was wearing my mom's muffin pan. [very flat] As a crown. [pause] [sheepish, quick] I'm so sorry. Please. [strained] Toast.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: No, yours wins. How big a fish?
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, conceding] no, yours wins. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very curious] how big a fish?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Big. No, sorry. TAXI big.
lines.script: [informing, flat] Big. [quick, correcting] No, sorry. [emphasized] TAXI big.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Huh. That'd tip the scales.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, pause] huh. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] that'd tip the scales.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Right. Toast. So I look out the window to see what kind of day it is, the sky's purple, and it turns out we're out of bread.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, resuming] right. toast. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, slow] so i look out the window to see what kind of day it is, [mellow, laid-back, low-key, tossed off] the sky's purple, [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very troubled] and it turns out we're out of bread.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Go back one.
lines.script: [sharp, very fast] Go back one.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The window?
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very confused] the window?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The PURPLE.
lines.script: [exasperated] The [emphasized] PURPLE.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Oh. Yeah. All day. It's coming off the hills. The bread's the real problem.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] oh. yeah. all day. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, informing] it's coming off the hills. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very serious] the bread's the real problem.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Hills, then bread. I figure we walk up and poke it.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, agreeing] hills, then bread. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, suggesting] i figure we walk up and poke it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Poke it. Yes. But maybe just gently.
lines.script: [agreeing, quick] Poke it. Yes. [pause] [hesitant, softer] But maybe just [emphasized] gently.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Nara's already on it. She's been barking at it from your porch since breakfast.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, informing] nara's already on it. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, chuckling] she's been barking at it from your porch since breakfast.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then we're her backup.
lines.script: [deadpan, quick] Then we're her [emphasized] backup.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara, no jumping. Hello. Yes. Hello. That's my whole face. Thank you.
lines.script: [firm, loud] Nara, no jumping. [muffled] Hello. Yes. Hello. [very flat, informing] That's my whole face. [deadpan] Thank you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: No. This isn't that kind of stick. This is a work stick.
lines.script: [firm, quick] No. This isn't that kind of stick. [very serious, announcing] This is a [emphasized] work stick.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: She thinks you're sticking around.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] she thinks you're [mellow, laid-back, low-key, quick] sticking around.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Huh. Now it's between us and the bread.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, pause] huh. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very troubled] now it's between us and the bread.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Okay. Work stick. This is what you're for.
lines.script: [bracing, quick] Okay. Work stick. [announcing, very serious] This is what you're for.

lines.speaker: Mr. Washington
lines.text: Morning, Tom! Back from your folks? How's your mama?
lines.script: [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful, loud] Morning, Tom! [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, asking] Back from your folks? [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful] How's your mama?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Morning, Mr. Washington. She's well, thank you.
lines.script: [flat, greeting] Morning, Mr. Washington. [informing, quick] She's well, thank you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Still well! Thank you.
lines.script: [confused, quick] Still well! [very flat] Thank you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She's... consistently well.
lines.script: [hesitant, slow] She's... [pause] [very very deadpan] [emphasized] consistently well.

lines.speaker: Smoglet
lines.text: Ahem. You're in my way.
lines.script: [wet cough] Ahem. [rude, very flat] You're in my way.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Okay. So. You coughed on Mr. Washington's porch. He sweeps that porch every MORNING.
lines.script: [tight, slow] Okay. [pause] So. [accusatory, quick] You coughed on Mr. Washington's porch. [outraged] He sweeps that porch every [emphasized] MORNING.

lines.speaker: Smoglet
lines.text: Ahem. There's two of us.
lines.script: [wet cough] Ahem. [taunting, flat] There's two of us.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We can do this! I've done this one time.
lines.script: [rallying, loud] We can do this! [muttering, quick] I've done this one time.

lines.speaker: Miss Odette
lines.text: This gumbo is perfect. Doesn't need a thing.
lines.script: [thick Louisiana Creole accent, dazed] This gumbo is perfect. [thick Louisiana Creole accent, droning] Doesn't need a thing.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: She's never said that. Last week she sent a bowl back to herself.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, informing] she's never said that. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] last week she sent a bowl back to herself.

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: Everything's fine. Everything's fine.
lines.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, dazed] Everything's fine. [heavy Salvadoran accent, droning] Everything's fine.

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: Perfect. You cook so well, Tom.
lines.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, dazed] Perfect. [heavy Salvadoran accent, very flat] You cook so well, Tom.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Did you hear that? She said I cook WELL.
lines.script: [whispering, awed] Did you hear that? [astounded, quick] She said I cook [emphasized] WELL.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: She's in the smog, babe.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very flat] she's in the smog, babe.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I know. I'm keeping it.
lines.script: [conceding, quick] I know. [very smug] I'm keeping it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh, Observatory. Not you.
lines.script: [dismayed, slow] Oh, Observatory. [pause] [heartbroken, quiet] Not you.

lines.speaker: Ticket Flurry
lines.text: No parking Saturdays. Noon to two. You parked.
lines.script: [reciting, fast] No parking Saturdays. Noon to two. [accusatory, very flat] You parked.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I was in New York on Saturday. I still have my boarding pass.
lines.script: [indignant, fast] I was in New York on Saturday. [informing, very precise] I still have my [emphasized] boarding pass.

lines.speaker: Ticket Flurry
lines.text: Denied.
lines.script: [very very flat, final] Denied.

lines.speaker: Canyon Coyote
lines.text: Dog. Run with us. We never sit.
lines.script: [low, growling] Dog. [eager, fast] Run with us. [taunting] We never sit.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Easy. She's spoken for. You want the rest of my soda?
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, slow] easy. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, informing] she's spoken for. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, offering] you want the rest of my soda?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's the block. From the pond. The dragonfly was in one just like it.
lines.script: [hushed, slow] That's the block. From the pond. [informing, quick] The dragonfly was in one just like it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You didn't mention a dragonfly.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very flat] you didn't mention a dragonfly.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The fish took up a lot of the story.
lines.script: [sheepish, quick] The [emphasized] fish took up a lot of the story.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's not glass. It's not resin. I don't like it.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, slow] it's not glass. it's not resin... [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very flat] i don't like it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You don't like it? You liked the talking cloud.
lines.script: [astounded, quick] You don't like it? [accusatory] You liked the talking [emphasized] cloud.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The cloud made sense.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] the cloud made sense.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Grace, reporting in. There's a lemon stuck in an orange block, and Nara found a burnt flashbulb right next to it. I wrote it down.
lines.script: [informing, very flat] Grace, reporting in. [quick, listing] There's a lemon stuck in an orange block, and Nara found a burnt flashbulb right next to it. [deadpan] I wrote it down.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Tata, don't touch it! Send me a picture of both. And don't let Nara lick it.
lines.script: [bossy, loud] Tata, don't touch it! [ordering, quick] Send me a picture of both. [very stern] And don't let Nara lick it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: GAH! I've got you, Nara. We're fine. We're both fine.
lines.script: [shrieking] GAH! [breathless, fast] I've got you, Nara. We're fine. [shaky, high] We're both fine.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: RUMBLE. A flash woke me up. Now everybody runs.
lines.script: [huge, very deep] RUMBLE. [accusatory, slow] A flash woke me up. [very sad] Now everybody runs.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me. You're wearing the Observatory. Please don't drop it.
lines.script: [urgent, quick] Excuse me. [informing, very flat] You're wearing the [emphasized] Observatory. [pleading] Please don't drop it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me. Mr. Shake. How are you doing?
lines.script: [out of breath, soft] Excuse me. Mr. Shake. [pause] [hushed, asking] How are you doing?

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: RUMBLE. ...Nobody asks. They just run.
lines.script: [huge, astounded] RUMBLE. [very quiet, slow] ...Nobody asks. [very sad] They just run.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I don't run. I've been sleeping on you every Sunday. Sorry. I thought you were a hill.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, informing] i don't run. i've been sleeping on you every sunday. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, very apologetic] sorry. i thought you were a hill.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: RUMBLE. That was you? You snore.
lines.script: [huge, astounded] RUMBLE. That was you? [accusatory, very flat] You snore.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Yeah. That's fair.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, conceding] yeah. that's fair.

lines.speaker: The Big Shake
lines.text: My pipe itches. Hold on. Hh... HHH...
lines.script: [huge, complaining] My pipe itches. [urgent, quick] Hold on. [sneezing] Hh... HHH...

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes. I saw. Very good. May I?
lines.script: [very flat, quick] Yes. I saw. Very good. [pause] [asking, soft] May I?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Gold. And there's a lemon stamped on it.
lines.script: [hushed, amazed] Gold. [informing, quick] And there's a lemon stamped on it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Huh. Sour dough.
lines.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, pause] huh. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, deadpan] sour dough.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She's well, Mr. Washington.
lines.script: [bracing, very flat] She's well, Mr. Washington.

lines.speaker: Mr. Washington
lines.text: Glad to hear it. Tell her I said hello.
lines.script: [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very relaxed] Glad to hear it. [older African American man, warm Louisiana drawl, thick Louisiana drawl, very cheerful] Tell her I said hello.

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: Tom! Who turned my pupusas? They're all wrong.
lines.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, sharp, loud] Tom! [heavy Salvadoran accent, accusatory] Who turned my pupusas? [heavy Salvadoran accent, disgusted] They're all [emphasized] wrong.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You told me I cook well.
lines.script: [pleading, quick] You told me I cook [emphasized] well.

lines.speaker: Doña Carmen
lines.text: I never said that.
lines.script: [heavy Salvadoran accent, very dismissive] I never said that.

lines.speaker: Miss Odette
lines.text: Sit down, both of you. This gumbo needs salt and you two need lunch.
lines.script: [thick Louisiana Creole accent, commanding] Sit down, both of you. [thick Louisiana Creole accent, complaining, quick] This gumbo needs salt [thick Louisiana Creole accent, informing] and you two need lunch.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We were going to get bread.
lines.script: [sheepish, quick] We were going to get bread.

lines.speaker: Miss Odette
lines.text: I have bread. Sit.
lines.script: [thick Louisiana Creole accent, very firm] I have bread. [thick Louisiana Creole accent, commanding] Sit.
